title: Tiny, cute magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='58' y='62' width='14' height='28' rx='7' fill='#ffb347' transform='rotate(-45 65 76)'/>
  <rect x='61' y='64' width='5' height='22' rx='3' fill='#ffe0a3' transform='rotate(-45 65 76)'/>
  <!-- handle joint -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='61' r='7' fill='#e8892b'/>
  <!-- lens rim -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='28' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='28' fill='none' stroke='#ffd54f' stroke-width='7'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='24' fill='#b3e5fc'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='24' fill='#c9f0ff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- glass shine -->
  <path d='M26 30 Q32 22 44 24' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- cute eyes inside lens -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='40' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#1b3b5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='40' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#1b3b5a'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='38.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='38.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M35 48 Q40 52 45 48' fill='none' stroke='#1b3b5a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='47' r='3' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='47' r='3' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
